summary: Irenic Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the closing of its IPO of 22,000,000 units at $10.00/unit ($220M gross), the partial exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment option for 3,253,188 additional units ($32.5M gross), and simultaneous private placements of 640,000 (initial) and 32,532 (additional) units to the sponsor and underwriters at $10.00/unit. The sponsor forfeited 11,703 Class B shares upon the over-allotment closing. The SPAC now has proceeds in trust to pursue an initial business combination, with a 45-day underwriter option to purchase up to 3,300,000 additional units still possible. Watch for the de-SPAC timeline and any target announcement.
